name: UserImpact
author: [https://github.com/codedbyjake Jake Linford]
description: Shows a user their own edit and article-view statistics on their user page.

UserImpactEnabled.description: Master switch for the whole extension. Set to false to disable the impact panel for everyone, regardless of individual preference.

UserImpactDefaultShow.description: Default value of the per-user "show my impact stats" preference for users who haven't set it themselves.

UserImpactPreferencesHeading.description: Overrides the heading text for the preferences section containing the impact-panel toggle. Leave empty to use the default ("Your impact").
